label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_first_00
text: 波琵我受到邀請，\n所以就來了～[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_first_01
text: 帕底亞寶可夢聯盟！\n四天王波琵就是我～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp01_00
text: 大哥哥！\n波琵我來了喔！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp01_00b
text: 大姐姐！\n波琵我來了喔！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp01_select_01
text: 妳來了呀！

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp01_select_02
text: 沒有迷路嗎？

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp01_02
text: 因為有聯盟的人\n陪我一起坐飛機！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp01_03
text: 波琵我是第一次來海外，\n雖然很想很想去玩……[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp01_04
text: 但是波琵我會教藍～莓的大家\n寶可夢的事情的！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp01_select_03
text: 加油！

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp01_select_04
text: 波琵妳好棒！

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp01_05
text: 欸嘿！我會加油的～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp02_00
text: 因為受到邀請，\n所以波琵我又來了！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp02_01
text: 學校真是個好玩的地方～[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp02_02
text: 波琵我還沒有\n去學校上過學。[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp02_03
text: 教室，還有老師，通通都是\n第一次看到，我好興奮喔～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp02_04
text: 有一天波琵我也能當學生\n去學校上課嗎～……[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp02_select_01
text: 當然了！

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp02_select_02
text: 我想會的……

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp02_06
text: ……因為波琵我和\n周圍的人有一點不一樣，\r\n所以忍不住有些擔心！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp02_07
text: 大哥哥，\n謝謝你這麼貼心！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp02_07b
text: 大姐姐，\n謝謝妳這麼貼心！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_01
text: 在大哥哥的眼中，\n你覺得波琵我看起來像是幾歲呢？[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_01b
text: 在大姐姐的眼中，\n妳覺得波琵我看起來像是幾歲呢？[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_select_01
text: ６歲

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_select_02
text: ９歲

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_02
text: 哼～！波琵我才不是\n那麼小的小朋友呢！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_02b
text: 哎呀呀～！好厲害呀！\n第一次有人答對！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_02c
text: 哎呀呀～！波琵我\n看起來那麼像個大姐姐呀～！？[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_03
text: 波琵我今年９歲，\n以我的年紀，其實已經\r\n可以到學院上學了喔！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_04
text: 但是波琵我的寶可夢太強了，\n會給大家添麻煩……\r\n所以我就主動放棄入學了。[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_05
text: 然後也慈姐姐她就來邀請\n波琵我當四天王……[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_06
text: 但是看著藍～莓的大家，\n波琵我發現了一件事情！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_07
text: 波琵我只是個寶可夢很強的\n普通少女！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_08
text: 所以從明年開始波琵我想一邊當四天王，\n一邊到學院上學～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_select_04
text: 好期待呀！

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_select_05
text: 我們一起去上學！

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_sp03_09
text: 當然波琵我的回答是\n好～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_trade_01_00
text: 波琵我好期待能去學院上學，\n都快要等不及了！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: coach_paldea4kings_hagane_trade_01_01
